description: Historical files in The Last Marker that were saved in a different shape than the handoff schemas. The production audit reports them and does not treat them as a new failure. A file that is not on this list must validate.

files.reason: The sound designer writes a flat assets list plus generated_at. The schema expects version, layers, and created_at.
The production agent writes preview clips with local_path and status preview. The schema expects version, created_at, clip_id, file_path, and a status from its list.
The QA agent writes overall_verdict, findings, and review_date. The schema expects verdict, issues, review_pass, version, and reviewed_at.
Same shape as qa-report-v1. The findings are real; the field names do not match the continuity-report schema.
